title: Tatsuki Fujimoto’s ‘Chainsaw Man’ Vol. 24 Tops Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 as Mizuki Tsujimura’s Latest Novel Debuts in Top 10
summary: Debuting at No. 2 is Dandadan Vol. 24.
contentText:
Tatsuki Fujimoto’s Chainsaw Man Vol. 24 hits No. 1 on the Billboard Japan Book Hot 100, on the list released June 11.

The volume is the concluding installment of Part 2 of the popular series, whose anime adaptation of the Reze arc has been a major box office hit. The volume dominates the brick-and-mortar and e-books metrics this week.

Debuting at No. 2 is Dandadan Vol. 24, which hits No. 2 in both brick-and-mortar and e-books, and No. 9 in e-commerce (EC). BORUTO -TWO BLUE VORTEX- Vol. 8 follows at No. 3. Rounding out the top 5 are Kono Oto Tomare! Vol. 34 at No. 4 and Mato Seihei no Slave Vol. 21 at No. 5, making the upper tier a showcase of popular manga series on Shonen Jump .

The new two-volume novel Fire Dome by Mizuki Tsujimura enters at No. 10 (Vol. 1) and No. 18 (Vol. 2), respectively. The commemorative work marking the author’s 22nd debut anniversary, the volumes have already reached a cumulative print run of 260,000 copies. Vol. 1 tops the social media metric, signaling strong early interest.

The Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 is a comprehensive chart combining physical sales, e-books, library loans, subscription data and social media activity. Below are the top 10 titles on this week’s list, tracking the period from June 1 to 7.

(Numbers in parentheses indicate the title’s metric placements for brick-and-mortar, EC, e-books, subscriptions, and social media, top 20 only. English title given if translations or adaptations exist.)
